institution_name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

coverage.notes: Catalogue scope selected: the official Registry lists approximately 30 undergraduate degrees across seven undergraduate-serving schools, and the international admissions site describes the institution as English-medium. Four representative first degrees were investigated, not an exhaustive 2027 international programme list. Source catalogues consulted: Registry Undergraduate Degree Programmes (all school sections plus double majors), international Schools and Subjects (seven schools), and 2027 Entry Requirements. The main university describes eight schools including the School of Public Policy; the Registry does not list an undergraduate degree under Public Policy, so it is not included as an undergraduate school here. Special dual-campus/double-major pathways shown on the Registry are not assumed to be distinct 2027 international first-year application choices. Medicine is an English-classroom exception with Chinese clinical placement progression; 2027 availability and programme-specific conditions must be reconfirmed in the live application form.

institution.summary: English-medium joint-venture university in Shenzhen, China; undergraduate programmes are approved by CUHK, which issues CUHK degrees.

programmes.name: Financial Engineering
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science in Financial Engineering (BSc)
programmes.about: An English-taught quantitative finance degree jointly offered by management and economics, science and engineering, and data science, with Quantitative Finance and FinTech streams.
programmes.overview: Students combine financial theory with mathematics, computational methods and data analysis. The Quantitative Finance stream emphasises securities, derivative instruments and pricing, while the FinTech stream applies data science to financial services. The school lists foundational finance and microeconomics alongside data structures, investment analysis, financial-data analysis and optional machine learning. Students select a stream within one degree, rather than applying for a separate degree for each stream. The programme supports finance- and technology-related progression.

programmes.name: Computer Science and Engineering
programmes.credential: Bachelor's degree (CUHK; exact award title not confirmed)
programmes.about: A School of Data Science undergraduate programme combining mathematics, computer-system design and programming, with applications in machine learning, artificial intelligence and data science.
programmes.overview: The programme develops mathematical foundations, programming, computer-system analysis and design. Machine learning, artificial intelligence and data science are identified by the school as key application directions, with opportunities to connect computing to other fields. The curriculum aims to equip students to analyse and develop software and computing systems rather than simply use existing tools. The school describes both professional computing work and further research or postgraduate study as possible directions.

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Engineering in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: A four-year engineering bachelor's degree dedicated to AI fundamentals and applications, taught through an interdisciplinary foundation followed by specialist study and practical projects.
programmes.overview: In the first two years, students build foundations in mathematics, physics, programming and introductory artificial intelligence. The second half of the degree develops specialised work in areas such as AI theory, embodied AI, scientific applications and business applications. The school describes small-group, mentor-led research and collaborations with industry as part of advanced practical study. This combines theoretical understanding with building and applying AI systems, with pathways into technical careers or further research.

programmes.name: Clinical Medicine
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Medicine (CUHK-Shenzhen) and Bachelor of Science in Clinical Medicine (CUHK)
programmes.campus: CUHK-Shenzhen and local hospital clinical teaching bases, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
programmes.language: English-taught academic courses; HSK 4 Chinese needed to begin Year 3 local-hospital clerkship
programmes.about: A six-year direct-entry first medical degree with English-taught academic courses, early clinical exposure and hospital rotations; Chinese proficiency is essential for clinical progression.
programmes.overview: Years one and two emphasise medical science, including anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, microbiology, genetics, immunology and pharmacology. The school integrates introductory clinical activities, research and medical AI before more extensive hospital-based practice begins in Year 3. Students also encounter medical ethics, communication, leadership and specialist training elements. Progression to the local-hospital clerkship requires HSK 4 Chinese; failure to obtain it prevents continuation. Graduates who complete the six-year programme receive the stated CUHK-Shenzhen and CUHK degrees.

faculties.name: School of Management and Economics
faculties.guidance: Undergraduate business areas include finance, economics, accountancy, global business and marketing; the joint Financial Engineering degree permits direct Year 1 selection. Strong mathematics preparation matters especially for quantitative subjects.

faculties.name: School of Science and Engineering
faculties.guidance: Undergraduate study includes mathematics, physics, chemistry, materials, energy and electrical/computer engineering. Science/engineering-track preparation and relevant recent school subjects are important for admission.

faculties.name: School of Humanities and Social Science
faculties.guidance: The undergraduate catalogue includes translation, applied psychology, English studies, urban management and international organisations/global governance. Consult the international admissions site for first-year school preferences.

faculties.name: School of Data Science
faculties.guidance: Undergraduate areas include statistics, computer science and engineering, and data science and big data technology; the school also co-offers Financial Engineering.

faculties.name: School of Medicine
faculties.guidance: International candidates may apply for Medicine school majors. Clinical Medicine is a separate direct-entry six-year programme with additional subject/qualification checks and HSK 4 progression to clinical placements.

faculties.name: School of Artificial Intelligence
faculties.guidance: Offers the four-year BEng in Artificial Intelligence; published curriculum describes a two-year fundamentals phase followed by two years of advanced applied study.

faculties.name: School of Music
faculties.guidance: Undergraduate areas include performance, musicology and composition; the 2027 international scholarship schedule differs from the other schools. Ask the school about any programme-specific audition or submission requirement.

claims.statement: Programme description for Financial Engineering: An English-taught quantitative finance degree jointly offered by management and economics, science and engineering, and data science, with Quantitative Finance and FinTech streams. Students combine financial theory with mathematics, computational methods and data analysis. The Quantitative Finance stream emphasises securities, derivative instruments and pricing, while the FinTech stream applies data science to financial services. The school lists foundational finance and microeconomics alongside data structures, investment analysis, financial-data analysis and optional machine learning. Students select a stream within one degree, rather than applying for a separate degree for each stream. The programme supports finance- and technology-related progression.

claims.statement: Programme description for Clinical Medicine: A six-year direct-entry first medical degree with English-taught academic courses, early clinical exposure and hospital rotations; Chinese proficiency is essential for clinical progression. Years one and two emphasise medical science, including anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, microbiology, genetics, immunology and pharmacology. The school integrates introductory clinical activities, research and medical AI before more extensive hospital-based practice begins in Year 3. Students also encounter medical ethics, communication, leadership and specialist training elements. Progression to the local-hospital clerkship requires HSK 4 Chinese; failure to obtain it prevents continuation. Graduates who complete the six-year programme receive the stated CUHK-Shenzhen and CUHK degrees.
